name: Sattrix Information Security Ltd
about: Founded in 2013, Sattrix Information Security Incorporated in 2013, Sattrix Information Security Ltd provides Information security and cyber security services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SISL develops customer-centric cyber security solutions and delivers end-to-end cybersecurity services to enterprises in the India, USA and UAE. It helps organizations to protect their data from unauthorized access and against security threats. Company designs and builds data security solutions on cloud and on-premise based
 on the client requirement

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 177 days.
Working capital days have increased from 46.2 days to 76.7 days
